comment.description: Why the edge exists; a decision token (`adr:0007`) makes it citable.

from.description:
The module the edge leaves, as the graph names it (in a `fleet`, prefixed with the
repository's name: `web/src/api/client.ts`).

kind.description: What the edge stands for: `http`, `queue`, or any word the team uses.

to.description: The module the edge reaches, as the graph names it.

OpenApiPair.description: One OpenAPI client folder and the server document it calls.

client.description:
The folder of the generated client, as the graph names it (`web/src/api/generated/`):
only its modules are read for operation ids.

server.description:
The server's OpenAPI document (JSON or YAML), as the graph names its path
(`api/openapi.json`).

description:
`edges.yaml`: the edges declared by hand, and the OpenAPI client and server pairs whose
operations declare more.

$schema.description: The schema this file is written against.

openapi.description: OpenAPI client folders and the server documents their operations are matched against.

title: Rulebearing declared edges
